label: 0042 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): 0041 with a slow Tokachi-oki state, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: 0041 with a second Tokachi-oki state on the BEL beside the first, decaying much more slowly (Omori law, c = 20 yr; first-year prior 20 mm/yr, still 10 mm/yr in 2025) and spread wider (450 km Gaussian taper). Window cross-validation is 253 above 0041's and higher in 30 of 33 windows; 181 of the gain is after Tohoku. Slower and broader versions score better, and with the slow state the block departures add almost nothing. The state isn't mantle relaxation: it comes out as a slip deficit beneath eastern Hokkaido that on its own moves the sites 4–16 mm/yr west. The first Tokachi-oki state grows to more than cancel it at first, so the two together change the shape of the Hokkaido time series: the model moves about 6–7 mm/yr further east in the first months after the earthquake and then returns faster, ending 1–4 mm/yr west of 0041 in 2005–2011 and up to 1.5 mm/yr west by 2025. That removes most of 0041's eastward misfit in 2007–2011 and about halves it after 2016, but adds about 4 mm/yr of misfit in early 2004. The slow state also reaches northern Tohoku, so part of the late gain may be a broad post-Tohoku signal that it happens to fit. The 1997–2003 offset, the static rotations and the preferred correlated-noise length are unchanged; holding the Hokkaido rotations at a fit to the 1997–2003 velocities scores 42 lower and leaves the slow state as it is. Tohoku afterslip is unchanged. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
